name: 烛龙
scope: Medium generation specification only; parent submits API calls and separately reviews actual output. No runtime or readiness change.

source.text: 西北海外，赤水之北，有章尾山。有神，人面蛇身而赤，直目正乘，其暝乃晦，其視乃明，不食不寢不息，風雨是謁。是燭九陰，是謂燭龍。
鍾山之神名曰燭陰，視為晝，瞑為夜，吹為冬，呼為夏，不飲，不食，不息，息為風，身長千里。在無啓之東。其為物，人面，蛇身，赤色，居鍾山下。

sourceVerification.basis: Research commit content and provenance; 2026-11-08 fresh WebFetch of both chapters confirms human face, red serpent body, 直目正乘, and distinct 烛龙/烛阴 paragraphs.
boundaries: 章尾山/燭龍 and 鍾山/燭陰 remain separately quoted; do not silently equate the mountains.
千里 and winter/summer clauses occur in 海外北經; they are not inserted into 大荒北經.
直目正乘 is preserved verbatim; it does not establish vertical slit pupils. 九陰 is not an eye or head count.
No crown, horns, wings, limbs or creator title is explicit in these passages.

inferred.item: One complete human head and face continuously integrated with a red serpent
inferred.basis: 人面蛇身而赤 is explicit. Full cranium, short hair, ordinary paired lidded eyes, head-to-neck transition, slenderness and pointed tail complete unspecified anatomy. Eyes face forward without presenting this choice as a translation of 直目.

inferred.item: No horns, wings, arms or legs; no crown
inferred.basis: Minimal design choice avoiding unsupported dragon additions. It is not a textual statement that the source explicitly forbids appendages.

inferred.item: Vermilion scales, lighter belly and extended shallow S
inferred.basis: Red color is explicit, exact tones, scale structure, thousand-li viewing scale and open production pose are inferred. Eye closing and day/night changes belong to later animation and effect design.

jobs.role: One continuous human-faced red serpent, complete head to pointed tail

currentModel.evidence: Research commit and provenance record no credible complete human-faced serpent. An old isolated human bust and tail are candidates for their original roles, not an accepted Zhulong. No new output is claimed; no fresh inventory audit was performed.

acceptance: Read actual front, rear, left and right orthographic images before any High decision; inspect face-throat and tail-tip closeups.
One unmistakable human face and complete cranium, no dragon muzzle, crown, horns, antlers, extra eyes or forced slit pupils.
Continuous rounded throat-to-neck transition without bust, human chest, floating face, collar, triangular bib or pasted cap.
Whole volumetric red serpent including belly and fully tapered tail; no ring, ouroboros, body crossing, welded ends or clipped tail tip.
Eyes and lids must remain readable for later opening/closing; no baked fire or light that conceals anatomy.

Later full production still needs finite skinning, belly contact or full-body clearance, idle/walk/special continuous Read captures, StrictMode cleanup, special return and separated source/inferred UI. This task provides no such pass.
